_comment: Copy to questions.json and replace these with questions about YOUR project. `q` is phrased the way a CTO would look something up while writing a card; `kw` is the same lookup as keywords. A hit counts only when ONE returned item matches every regex in `must`. Check each answer really is in the project's board.json, .ai-teammates/RULES.md or git history (`bench.py check` refuses to score a question the corpus cannot answer). Keep one `abstain` question whose answer is NOT in the project: it measures what a useless lookup costs.

questions.q: where does production get deployed and why

questions.src: git log (the newest decision, not the first one)
questions.q: which database does the project use now

questions.src: nothing in the project mentions it
questions.q: what is the Kubernetes cluster setup
